payload.reason: The evidence clearly identifies the datasets used for evaluation, including specific NIST datasets and the Baidu Speech Translation Corpus (BSTC).

claims.text: The evaluation is conducted on the NIST datasets (NIST02, NIST03, NIST04, NIST05, NIST06, NIST08) and the Baidu Speech Translation Corpus (BSTC).
The BSTC dataset is used to evaluate the robustness of translation models with ASR errors and speech irregularities.
Models are initially trained on the NIST dataset and then fine-tuned on the BSTC dataset to improve performance.
